'''Jack Freeman Kayil''' (born 27 January 2006) is a German professional [[basketball]] player for [[Alba Berlin]] of the German [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL).

==Career==
===Club career===
Kayil played in the youth system of the Berlin-based club TuS Neukölln,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.tusbasket.de/2019/01/30/u14-spieler-jack-schafft-es-in-den-bbv-kader/ |title=U14-Spieler Jack schafft es in den BBV-Kader |website=TuS Neukölln |date=30 January 2019 |access-date=30 September 2023}}</ref> before joining the youth academy of [[Alba Berlin]]. During the 2022–23 season, he made 20 appearances for Alba Berlin’s second men’s team in the 2nd Regionalliga, averaging 12.3 points per game.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.basketball-bund.net/statistik.do?reqCode=statBesteWerferArchiv&_top=-1&_absolut=0 |title=Top scorers (Season: 2022–2023) – 2nd Regionalliga Men East |website=German Basketball Federation |access-date=30 September 2023}}</ref>

With Alba Berlin’s youth team, Kayil won the German U19 championship in 2023 and was named the best rookie of the Nachwuchs-Basketball-Bundesliga (NBBL).<ref name="rookie">{{cite web |url=https://www.2basketballbundesliga.de/rookie-of-the-year-der-nbbl-kommt-nach-vechta/ |title=Rookie of the Year of the NBBL moves to Vechta |website=2. Basketball-Bundesliga |date=17 July 2023 |access-date=30 September 2023}}</ref>

In July 2023, [[SC Rasta Vechta]] announced Kayil’s signing, initially assigning him to the club’s youth program and second men’s team in the [[ProA|ProA league]].<ref name="rookie" /> In August 2023, Kayil took part in the [[Basketball Without Borders]] scouting camp organised by [[FIBA]] and the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.talkbasket.net/170901-basketball-without-borders-europe-2023-mvps-and-sportsmanship-awardees-honored |title=Basketball Without Borders Europe 2023: MVPs and sportsmanship awardees honored |website=TalkBasket |date=29 August 2023 |access-date=30 September 2023}}</ref>

In May 2024, playing for the joint youth team Quakenbrück/Vechta, Kayil won another German U19 championship and was named Most Valuable Player of the final tournament.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rasta-vechta.de/home/einzelansicht/im-ziel-young-rasta-dragons-sind-deutscher-meister/ |title=Young Rasta Dragons crowned German champions |website=SC Rasta Vechta |date=12 May 2024 |access-date=12 May 2024}}</ref>

After the conclusion of the 2023–24 season, Kayil left Vechta and signed with Serbian club [[KK Mega Basket]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.2basketballbundesliga.de/jack-kayil-verlaesst-rasta-vechta-ii/ |title=Jack Kayil leaves Rasta Vechta II |website=2. Basketball-Bundesliga |date=8 May 2024 |access-date=9 May 2024}}</ref> During the 2024–25 season in the [[ABA League]], he averaged 7.7 points across 18 appearances.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/player/4790/24/1/jack-kayil/ |title=Jack Kayil |website=ABA League |access-date=11 June 2025}}</ref>

In 2025, Kayil returned to [[Alba Berlin]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rbb24.de/sport/beitrag/2025/06/basketball-bundesliga-bbl-alba-berlin-transfer-jack-kayil.html |title=Alba brings Jack Kayil back to Berlin |website=Rundfunk Berlin-Brandenburg |date=11 June 2025 |access-date=11 June 2025}}</ref>

===National team career===
In 2022, Kayil competed at the U16 Division B European Championship and won the tournament with the [[Germany men's national under-16 basketball team|Germany U16 national team]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.basketball-bund.de/u16-jungen-sind-b-europameister/ |title=U16 boys win Division B European Championship |website=German Basketball Federation |date=2022 |access-date=30 September 2023}}</ref>

At the 2023 U18 European Championship, he averaged 10 points per game and helped Germany secure the bronze medal.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2023/team/Germany |title=Germany – U18 European Championship 2023 |website=FIBA |access-date=30 September 2023}}</ref> In August 2024, Kayil won the gold medal with the [[Germany men's national under-18 basketball team|Germany U18 national team]] at the European Championship held in [[Tampere]], Finland.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.basketball-bund.de/gold-em-triumph-fuer-u18-jungen/ |title=GOLD!!! EM-Triumph für U18-Jungen |website=German Basketball Federation |date=4 August 2024 |access-date=4 August 2024|language=de}}</ref>

In November 2024, national team head coach [[Álex Mumbrú]] called Kayil up to the senior [[Germany men's national basketball team|Germany national team]] for the first time,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.basketball-bund.de/herren-bundestrainer-alex-mumbru-nominiert-19-spieler/ |title=Head coach Álex Mumbrú nominates 19 players |website=German Basketball Federation |date=11 November 2024 |access-date=18 November 2024}}</ref> where he made his debut in a [[EuroBasket 2025 qualification|EuroBasket 2025 qualifier]] against [[Sweden men's national basketball team|Sweden]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Revanche in der EM-Quali gegen Schweden: DBB-Team feiert mit 80:61 wichtigen ersten Sieg unter Alex Mumbru|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241210174645/https://www.easycredit-bbl.de/de/n/news/2024/november/erstmals-als-weltmeister-dbb-team-startet-mit-goldjunge-und-drei-em-helden-gegen-montenegro-in-die-em-quali/ |access-date=25 November 2024|language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Jack Kayil EuroBasket 2025 Qualifiers profile|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-eurobasket-2025-qualifiers/teams/germany/314821-jack-kayil|work=fiba.basketball|access-date=22 November 2024}}</ref>

At the [[2025 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup|2025 FIBA U19 World Cup]], Kayil reached the final with Germany, where the team lost to the United States.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.sport1.de/news/basketball/wm/2025/07/u19-basketballer-verpassen-sensation-im-wm-finale |title=Germany’s U19 team falls short in World Cup final |website=Sport1 |date=6 July 2025 |access-date=6 July 2025}}</ref> He averaged 11.1 points, 3.6 rebounds and 6.6 assists per game during the tournament.<ref>{{cite news|title=Jack Kayil 2025 FIBA U19 World Cup profile|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-u19-basketball-world-cup-2025/teams/germany/314821-jack-kayil|work=fiba.basketball|access-date=6 July 2025}}</ref> At the end 2025, Kayil played two matches for the Germany senior team in the [[2027 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification (Europe)|2027 FIBA World Cup qualifiers]], helping them in wins over [[Israel men's national basketball team|Israel]] and [[Cyprus men's national basketball team|Cyprus]], leading Germany in assists in the second game.<ref>{{cite news|title=Jack Kayil 2027 FIBA World Cup European Qualifiers profile|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-basketball-world-cup-2027-european-qualifiers/teams/germany/314821-jack-kayil|work=fiba.basketball|access-date=28 November 2025}}</ref>
